# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery and inspiration platform enabling users to find, save, and share ideas through pins and boards, with robust analytics and advertising tools for creators and businesses.

Pinterest offers a comprehensive ecosystem including content discovery across regions (Australia, South Africa), developer APIs for integrations, analytics for performance tracking, and advertising solutions. The platform supports diverse content categories from home decor and fashion to DIY projects and family activities.

## Key Topics

- Pins and Boards
- Visual Discovery
- Pinterest Analytics
- Pinterest Ads
- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Content Performance
- Audience Insights
- Social Media Analytics
- API for Shopping
- Home Ideas and Aesthetics
- Fashion and Lifestyle
- DIY and Creative Projects
- Family Activities

## Core Platform

- [Pinterest Official Profile](https://www.pinterest.com/pinterest/): Official Pinterest profile showcasing curated boards and collections
- [Pinterest Ideas - Australia](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Pinterest ideas gallery for Australia: discover trending content & categories
- [Pinterest Ideas - South Africa](https://za.pinterest.com/ideas/): Pinterest ideas hub for South Africa: trends, fashion & lifestyle inspiration

## Business Tools

- [Pinterest Analytics](https://analytics.pinterest.com/): Pinterest Analytics platform for tracking pins, audience insights & metrics
- [Pinterest Ads](https://ads.pinterest.com/expert/): Pinterest Ads expert program with personalized campaign support

## Developer Resources

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/): Pinterest API platform for developers: conversions, shopping & analytics
